# Conduit

> Broker-neutral data streaming engine and Kafka Connect replacement. Pipelines move records from
> source connectors to destination connectors with processors in between; any-language plugins
> over gRPC/WASM; embeddable; agent-legible with stable error codes and an MCP server.

## Pipeline configuration
- [Config schema (v2, latest 2.2)](llms-full.txt): version, pipelines, connectors, processors, dead-letter-queue. Legacy v1 (1.1) still parsed.

## Built-in connectors
- file — A file source and destination plugin for Conduit.
- generator — A plugin capable of generating dummy records (in different formats).
- kafka — A Kafka source and destination plugin for Conduit, written in Go.
- log — A destination connector that logs all incoming records.
- postgres — Conduit connector for PostgreSQL
- s3 — An S3 source and destination plugin for Conduit, written in Go.
(6 built-in connectors; full parameters in llms-full.txt)

## Error codes
- 187 stable error codes, dotted `domain.name` reasons, each with a gRPC status class. Full list with descriptions in llms-full.txt.
- CLI `--json`: a failing command prints one JSON object on stdout whose `error` carries `code`, `message`, `suggestion` and `configPath`; the exit code is 2 (validation), 3 (environment) or 1 (runtime).

## MCP tools
- Read: deploy, doctor, dry_run, inspect, kc_migrate, lint, repair, validate
- Write (require --allow-mutations): apply, repair_apply, scaffold_connector, scaffold_processor, start, stop
(14 tools; full schemas in llms-full.txt)

## Deployment
- [docker-compose quickstart](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/tree/main/deploy/docker-compose): `docker compose up -d --wait` starts a pinned, signed image with a running pipeline; state on a named volume.
- [systemd, ECS and Nomad examples](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/tree/main/deploy): examples, not supported products. Set the stop timeout above 30 s so SIGTERM can drain; probes are `/healthz` (liveness) and `/readyz` (readiness), both open without the API token.
- [Ambient cloud credentials](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/blob/main/docs/operations/ambient-credentials.md): built-in connectors use the host's identity (for example the AWS default chain) only when the operator sets `connectors.ambient-credentials.enabled=true` with exact `allow-resources`; a pipeline must name `builtin:s3`. Off by default.
- [Environment variables in settings](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/blob/main/docs/operations/env-allowlist.md): `${VAR}` in a connector or processor setting expands only for names the operator lists in `env.allow`; otherwise `config.env_var_not_allowed`. Off by default; not settable over the API.
- [Outbound HTTP from built-in processors](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/blob/main/docs/operations/outbound-http-egress.md): `webhook.http`, `ollama.request`, `openai.*` and `cohere.*` refuse private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses (`processor.egress_blocked`), on every redirect hop, and ignore proxy variables; the operator exempts exact destinations with `processors.egress.builtin-allow`.
- [Connector egress](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/blob/main/docs/operations/connector-egress.md): built-in connectors never connect to a cloud metadata endpoint (`connector.egress_blocked`); API writers are trusted to choose other targets, and the operator can confine them with `connectors.egress.allow`.
- [File access](https://github.com/ConduitIO/conduit/blob/main/docs/operations/file-access.md): the `file` connector and `custom.javascript` (`script.path`, `require()`) are confined to the operator's `connectors.file.allowed-dirs` and `processors.javascript.allowed-dirs` (`config.path_not_allowed`).

## Building connectors
- [Acceptance suite v2](https://conduitdata.io/docs/developing/connectors/acceptance-suite-v2): `sdk.AcceptanceTestV2` (conduit-connector-sdk v0.16.0+, suite revision 2.0.0) is the bar for Conduit Certified. Claims go in `AcceptanceCapabilities`; `CONDUIT_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT=<path>` writes a JSON report. The report is evidence, not proof: until the registry re-runs the suite, Certified rests on maintainer review and the registry check runs in warning mode. Throughput cases record records/s and fail only on a stall or rejected record; they are not benchmarks.
